Managing Director Albert Costagliola has been working on cars since he was 15. A lifelong passion for cars has become his esteemed career. He enjoys enhancing performance and tidying up wiring as facets of his profession.

Albert founded Albert's Auto Electrical in 2017, bringing this passion to his business. With 25 years of experience and a genuine love for his work, you can rely on his expert advice and specialist skills to achieve the performance and electrical solutions you desire.

Jayde joined us in August 2023 as our newest Tradesman Auto Electrician and has since become an invaluable member of our team. He brought a wealth of experience from the automotive electrical industry, along with a deep passion for cars, mirroring Albert's own enthusiasm.

On the tools, he is an excellent team player, always prepared to go above and beyond to complete a job. Outside the workshop, he enjoys spending time with family and friends, trips to the beach and sport. A keen learner, he continuously seeks new ways to enhance his skills.
